name: evidence-disclosure-reveal
goal: The explorer evidence spec opens each closed 'Assertions and recorded result' disclosure by a normal click before it asserts what a run asserted.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Failing: tests/e2e/harness-explorer-evidence.spec.ts:151 expects 'Surrounding spaces are removed' visible; it is hidden under the closed 'Assertions and recorded result' disclosure. reveal() clicks only buttons named Show; the page has none. Expected: reveal opens each closed result disclosure by a click. Product unchanged; data is present (locator resolves to the span).

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Untouched spec at 2b5536f (sha256 61dbf28a...fccf5): cd packages/reports && PROJECT_REPORTS_E2E_PORT=5837 PROJECT_REPORTS_ASSET_STORAGE=local bunx playwright test tests/e2e/harness-explorer-evidence.spec.ts -> 8 passed, 1 failed, exit 1. Line 151: expect(locator).toBeVisible() failed, Received: hidden. Log and failure screenshot: control evidence-disclosure/red-unchanged/.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Only packages/reports/tests/e2e/harness-explorer-evidence.spec.ts changed: +24 lines, 0 removed. reveal() keeps its Show clicks and now reads the open state of each 'Assertions and recorded result' disclosure and clicks only a closed one; 'Recorded JSON' is not touched. An opt-in proof() capture hook was added. All 75 original expectation, test-name and checkpoint lines are still present verbatim. No product file changed.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same command, final spec (sha256 3cb3bb24...5207ab): cd packages/reports && TAKE_SCREENSHOT=true SCREENSHOT_LABEL=after HARNESS_EXPLORER_SHOTS=<control>/shots PROJECT_REPORTS_E2E_PORT=5837 PROJECT_REPORTS_ASSET_STORAGE=local bunx playwright test tests/e2e/harness-explorer-evidence.spec.ts -> 9 passed, exit 0. Repeated 20 times without capture: 180 of 180. Before and after captures at the same checkpoint were inspected.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
